""ketigid"":

Where is the publicity for Rook City?!?!

While I love the updates and the videos that have come out…it does seem like where they are getting posted is only going to prior fans and those already kickstarting. Yes its still growing and it will continue to do so, but I must agree that it isn’t really being publicized that great. How can we get these great updates, stretch rewards, videos, etc out to those who haven’t seen in yet?

Contests? Designer diaries on BGG? Kickstarter expansion specific ads on BGG? I’ve suggested similar things before as I’ve seen these be effective, but there must be other great ideas out there? What do others think? What have you seen be effective advertising we can use to push Rook City?

(And this coming from one who doesn’t have the base game yet but is getting it with the kickstart)

I file it, along with many other comic ridiculosities, under my “Because Comics” heading.
